title: GRAIL twin (Ebb / Flow)
credit: Echoes of Exploration team (modelled in code from NASA reference drawings and photos)
note: One GRAIL twin in lunar orbit: washing-machine-sized bus (1.09 m high, 0.95 m wide, 0.76 m deep) with two fixed solar arrays beside its Sun-facing side, the 22 N main engine between them, the Ka-band ranging horn and S-band time-transfer antenna aimed at the other twin, low-gain and beacon antennas, star tracker, eight warm-gas thrusters and the four MoonKAM camera heads. Simplified and partly uncertain: the arrays' outline (drawn 1.58 x 1.20 m each, 1.9 m2) and slight sweep-back, and the exact places of the small antennas, star tracker and MoonKAM heads, are approximate. Ebb and Flow were mirror images; one model serves both.
